agent_notes: Government listing verified: both supplied 2025 NIRF pages contain Glocal University with city Saharanpur and state Uttar Pradesh.

Normal TLS requests to the expected NIRF and official hostnames returned the managed proxy's self-signed certificate-chain error; public GETs were retried with curl --insecure only after hostname confirmation.
The official homepage and Glocal University page confirm the Mirzapur Pole, Dist-Saharanpur, U.P.-247121 campus.
The current 2026-27 admission form loads an official JSON catalogue with 72 options.

Manual review is required because official department pages separately list additional programme names, including B.Voc/M.Voc and specialized engineering, science, arts, nursing, law, pharmacy, and paramedical variants, that are not synchronized with the 72-option admission endpoint; the Journalism & Mass Communication link redirects to the homepage and some course links are placeholders.

The courses array is the union of the current admission endpoint and programme names explicitly shown in official school-level Courses Offered sections; duration and eligibility remain null unless explicitly stated on the official catalogue page.
